newsitem.title: GERMANY: Home Shopping Network invests in Germany.
newsitem.headline: Home Shopping Network invests in Germany.

text.p: Home Shopping Network has taken a stake of 29 percent in Home Order Television (H.O.T.), Germany's first TV shopping channel, H.O.T. said on Tuesday.
Existing shareholders will lower their stakes in H.O.T. to make room for Home Shopping. No financial details were disclosed.
Quelle Schickedanz AG & Co. will cut its stake to 31 percent from 50 percent.

Thomas Kirch, son of Bavarian media magnate Leo Kirch, will cut his share to 33 percent from 40 percent previously. Georg Kofler, head of broadcaster Pro Sieben Media AG, will trim his stake to 7 percent from 10 percent.
The German home shopping channel was launched in October last year initially as a pilot project in Bavaria.

The H.O.T. network expects to achieve 65 million marks ($42 million) in sales this year. It said earlier this year it expected to break even by the year 2000 when sales were expected to rise to 300 million marks ($191 million) a year.
